posts.author: Reiken
posts.body:
Hey!
I'm working on a game that's kind of like a habit tracker mixed with a dungeon crawler — think
Solo Leveling
or
Persona 5
but with a self-improvement twist.
The core idea is that the game takes place in a sketchbook or journal — so I really want the menu to reflect that style. I’m aiming for something that looks like ripped paper, sticky notes, rough sketches, etc.
I'm a bit stuck on the best way to go about creating this kind of custom menu in RPG Maker MZ.
Would it be better to do this through event calls? I feel like eventing could
maybe
work, but I’m not sure how I’d go about displaying all the information like: items, stats, party info, skills ect.
Additionally, I’d love to have a submenu that shows the player’s  stats (since it's a habit tracker game) with buttons to increase those stats manually — is something like that possible? And if so, what would be the best approach for implementing that?
I should make it clear when I say the players stats I am referring to their ccombat stats.
Any advice, tips, or plugin recommendations would be super appreciated!
Thanks in advance : )
